elements.label: May Forecast P&L sheet replacing loading spinner

pattern.description: After the user picks 'May Forecast', the blank window with a loading spinner switches to the fully populated P&L sheet. The new version shows four months of actuals (Jan-Apr) and forecast for the rest, and a small settle follows the swap (energy decays over about 6 frames).
pattern.why_premium: The reload wait is trimmed to almost nothing, so the version switch feels instant. The new data lands exactly as the narration says 'four months of actuals', which makes the cause and effect obvious.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set(spinner, {autoAlpha: 0}); tl.fromTo(sheet, {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 1.03}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out', transformOrigin: 'center'}) timed to the word 'actuals'.
build_hint.remotion: Switch from the spinner to the sheet at f0; scale: interpolate(frame, [f0, f0 + 6], [1.03, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) with opacity stepping to 1 on f0.

notes: camera.move is 'none' (scale 0.948, small pan); the filmstrip frames after the swap look nearly identical. The decaying energy may be a slight scale settle or progressive cell rendering, so the scale_down here is uncertain. This is a screen-recorded page load, like e043.
